name: gizza-ai/diceware-passphrase
summary: Generate a memorable diceware passphrase from the EFF wordlist

tool.description: Generate a memorable multi-word diceware passphrase from the EFF wordlists with a cryptographic RNG, entirely locally. Pick the word count (default 6 ≈ 77.5 bits), the wordlist (EFF long or short), and the separator; optionally capitalize words, append a random digit/symbol, generate a batch, show the dice roll for each word, or supply your own physical dice rolls for a deterministic lookup. Returns the passphrase(s) plus entropy bits, a strength label, and an offline crack-time estimate.

add_number.description: Append one random digit 0-9 to the passphrase (~3.3 extra bits). Default false.

add_symbol.description: Append one random symbol from !@#$%^&*-+=? to the passphrase (~3.6 extra bits). Default false.

capitalize.description: Capitalize the first letter of every word (e.g. Abacus-Abdomen). Readability only — adds no entropy. Default false.

count.description: How many passphrases to generate (1-20, default 1; one per line). Must be 1 when 'rolls' is provided.

rolls.description: Optional physical dice rolls, digits 1-6 (spaces/commas between words allowed): 5 digits per word for eff-long (e.g. '62315 14534'), 4 for eff-short. When set, words are looked up deterministically instead of using the RNG.

separator.description: How words are joined: 'hyphen' (-, default), 'space', 'underscore' (_), 'dot' (.), 'none' (joined directly), or 'random-symbol' (a random symbol between each pair of words, ~3.6 extra bits per gap).

show_rolls.description: Also list the dice roll for each word (e.g. '62315  tiger') so you can verify against a printed wordlist. Default false.

wordlist.description: Word list: 'eff-long' (EFF long list, 7,776 words, 5 dice per word, ~12.9 bits/word, default) or 'eff-short' (EFF short list, 1,296 shorter words, 4 dice per word, ~10.3 bits/word).

words.description: Number of words in the passphrase (2-20, default 6 ≈ 77.5 bits with the EFF long list; use 8+ for vaults/master keys). Ignored when 'rolls' is provided.
